description: Stage B MIMIC-IV retrospective study protocol using de-identification anchor-year groups for temporal roles.
disclaimer: Prototype engineering study design — not IRB-approved clinical research, not FDA evidence, not for patient care.

dataset.name: MIMIC-IV Clinical Database
dataset.access: PhysioNet credentialed download or cloud + signed DUA required for Stage B
dataset.pin_policy: Record exact dataset version, extract date, and content hash of the derived cohort and label artifacts.

mimic_code.pin_policy: Record the exact git commit SHA and file hashes before label generation.

inclusion: First ICU stay per hospital admission

primary_event.name: sepsis3_onset
primary_event.definition: Sepsis-3-aligned suspected infection plus acute SOFA rise >= 2 from the pinned mimic-code concepts.
primary_event.onset_time: Availability-time of the observation that first completes the phenotype

secondary_events.name: aki_kdigo_stage_ge_1
secondary_events.definition: KDIGO stage >= 1 by creatinine and/or covered urine output

prediction_cadence.description: Replay canonical envelopes in availability-time order and score on each usable observation update.

availability_time_policy.fallback: Only use the documented adapter fallback when availability_time is absent; record the fallback.
availability_time_policy.corrections: Amended observations replace prior values only at their own availability_time
availability_time_policy.leakage_tests: Fail closed if future information is introduced

notes: Anchor-year groups preserve the release's approximate temporal ordering while avoiding cross-patient calendar comparisons.
The demo dataset remains plumbing-only and is not a Stage B result.

detection_timing.rule: Any governed or naive alert with event_time in [onset - 12h, onset + 6h]

primary_endpoint.name: noninferior_governed_sensitivity
primary_endpoint.definition: Among labeled-positive stays, fraction with at least one true-positive alert in the primary detection window
primary_endpoint.comparator: naive_sensitivity on the same stays and window

operating_point_selection.rule: Tune governance knobs on development, select the candidate on calibration subject to PE-1, freeze the winner, then evaluate test once.
operating_point_selection.selection_objective: min interruptive_reduction_ratio subject to PE-1 on calibration

ablations.rule: Freeze ablation configurations before test evaluation and report all once.

product_claims_evidence_map.claim: Shared alert governance reduces interruptive alert volume versus threshold-only scoring while preserving detection of labeled deterioration.
Episode arbitration produces one actionable patient episode instead of independent alert floods.
Clinical validation, FDA clearance, superiority, or patient-care readiness.

analysis_rules.multiple_comparisons: Primary and co-primary endpoints are pre-specified; secondaries and subgroups are descriptive.
